story.vex: One quiet exception from the top, and the whole program crumbles from there. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: leadership's own actions reinforce the program instead of quietly undermining it. Astro: "What I do matters more than what I sign."

LEADERSHIP ACTIONS — this month
-----------------------------------
action-1   Astro signed in at the console like every other cadet, even when running late
action-2   Command approved the security budget request in full, on schedule
action-3   A department head skipped the access review "just this once," no consequence noted
